selection: validation macro-F1, then validation precision, then fewer parameters; test scores never select a winner
test_policy: Only baseline and the validation-selected final candidate are evaluated on the locked test set. No further tuning using test errors in this version.
promotion_scope: Research task only; no automatic deployment to the four-tag skin diary.
stop_rule: Three predefined candidates, at most two epochs each; stop on resource failures or non-finite loss. A new cycle requires a new version and an untouched final holdout.
primary_metric: macro-F1 with invalid responses counted as errors
uncertainty: 95% parent-cluster bootstrap CI for paired test macro-F1 difference; small pilot, annotation-conditional and not clinical accuracy.
